title: 第7章 种子发芽第8章 宠物认主
content_zh:
第〇七章 种子发芽
聂空并没有松手，食指和拇指轻柔地捻动天针，其余八针便似拥有了灵性的活物一般，循着天针的颤动频率而颤动。
心海、玉明、天宫、黑庭、龙阙、神离、阳峰、迷泉和瑶池九大隐穴将聂空体内的经脉串成了一个整体，而瑶池穴便是这个整体的龙头和总枢纽。聂空以天针操控瑶池穴，心海等八个隐穴也跟随而动。
九针遥相应和，渐渐地，聂空的身体开始升温。
约莫一炷香时间过后，聂空手指的动作骤然加快，地针等八枚金针跟随天针剧颤，仿佛数千只蜜蜂同时扇动翅膀，嗡鸣之音清晰可闻。在聂空体表，豆大的汗珠涔涔而出，顷刻间头顶已是雾气蒸腾。
与此同时，聂空的经脉和血液好似烧开的热水，沸腾了起来，体内竟也传出了阵阵打雷般的轰鸣之声。
随后，犹如烈阳照耀下的冰雪，那些粘附在经脉内的药力开始慢慢融化开来，流水般朝瑶池穴汇聚。
看到房间里的奇异景象，门口的花眉早已嗔目结舌，那颗跳到嗓子眼的心儿不知何时已落了下去。
原来把这么长的金针扎进身体里真的没事！
聂空那急速揉动的手指和剧烈颤动的金针让人眼花缭乱，花眉暗暗咋舌。迷蒙的雾气，如同旋律般的嗡鸣……这一切被花眉看在眼里，听在耳中，聂空的身影顿时变得有些神秘起来，原本听聂空说那九根金针能够治病，她是半信半疑的，可现在，花眉对聂空的话已信了八分。
想到聂空终于有希望摆脱疾病的困扰，花眉心底由衷地高兴起来，只是高兴之余，她又有点疑惑，叔叔是从哪里学到这些的？
药力源源而来，很快便在天针针头处凝聚成一团。对于这些药力，聂空是打算利用九枚金针的震颤共鸣，将它们逼出体外。这些药力虽然珍贵，可惜十几年积攒下来的数量太过庞大，以聂空现在虚弱的体质，若是用“九转金针”之术全部吸收，估计聂空真的会被它们给补死。
骤地，紫罗幻灵香种子晃动起来。
“啊呀呀……”
隐隐间，聂空好似听到那枚种子里面传出了稚嫩的呼叫，紧接着，有股非常清楚的渴求之意从紫罗幻灵香种子传递到了聂空心中，就像是婴儿对于母乳，种子对药力竟有种本能的需求。
这枚紫罗幻灵香种子莫非有自己的意识？
聂空微一迟疑，中指便搭在了飞速转动的金针上，沉缓地敲击了一下，那凝聚在针头处的药力便落在了种子上。
只过了短短数秒，药力便被种子吸收殆尽。
聂空颇为惊讶，对那紫罗幻灵香种子更是好奇。倒要看看它到底会变成什么样子？聂空打定主意，越来越多从经脉中融化开来的药力被天针吸引，而后一股脑地投放到紫色种子上面。
一刻钟后，聂空揉捻天针的速度慢了下来，另外八枚金针也仿佛接到了命令，颤动的频率和幅度渐趋和缓。持续了这么长时间，聂空经脉中的药力融化了两成左右，已全被种子吸收。

不过，聂空并没有停止针灸的趋势。
所谓九转金针，总共需要进行九个循环。
刚才那次只是“九转金针”术的第一个阶段。在前世，聂空向来是针对患者的病症和病情轻重程度，来决定需要进行几个循环。当然，那个时候，他还是很少施展九转金针的，毕竟这种手法太耗费精神。以聂空对自己身体情况的估计，今晚能连续三个循环就已经是极限了。
对聂空来说，今晚的第一个循环只是预备工作，融化那两成药力只是顺便，第二循环才会针对血脉中的病根。只要解决了病根，那些凝结成实质的灵力和剩余的药力解决起来并不困难。
“能否有效，就看这次循环了。”
聂空呼吸轻细，心境平和，右手拇指和食指的动作没有像前次那样逐渐加快，而是速度骤然加快了数倍。
“轰！”
聂空身躯剧震，地针、人针等八枚金针竟同时荡起一圈残影，而后呈圆弧状迅疾地颤动起来。
九枚金针的震颤共鸣之力沿着经脉渗入血液，霎时，聂空体内血脉贲张，血液流速大幅度提升。大约两分钟过后，揉捻金针的动作又一次提速，聂空体内竟传出一片哗啦啦的细微声响，恍如溪流。
“嗯！”
聂空闷哼出声，阵阵撕裂般的痛楚从血脉迅速蔓延。虽是疼痛难当，聂空的拇指和食指却没有丝毫停顿，这个时候极其关键，稍有疏忽，便将前功尽弃。
随着血液的疾速流动，热力从九大隐穴升腾而起，眨眼间便已从温热转化为炽烈，而后散布全身。聂空的身体几乎以肉眼可见的速度泛红，不到十秒，聂空就通体红彤彤的，像是煮熟的虾米。
聂空全身肌肤颤栗，炙热与痛楚的煎熬，让他整个人似要爆炸开来。
房门口，看到聂空诡异的情状，花眉的俏脸上满是紧张，那颗心儿再次提起，此刻便是傻子也能看得出聂空正承受着难以言喻的折磨。在这样的时刻，花眉帮不上忙，只能紧咬着红唇，暗暗祈祷。
“咝咝……”
终于，在那轻微声响中，聂空再次感受到那股熟悉的奇异力量。不同的是，昨天那股力量无形无质，而现在，那股力量却凝结成一丝丝墨绿色**，从血液中分离开来，向瑶池穴汇集而去。
紫罗幻灵香种子又“啊呀呀”地叫了起来，就像是看到了某种稀世宝贝，聂空能从那声音中感受到了一股欢呼雀跃的意味。
果然，当聂空将最先抵达“瑶池穴”的那丝墨绿色**弹到紫罗幻灵香种子种子表层时，它便开始吸收了起来。只不过，这次它吸收的速度异常缓慢，与之前吸收药力相比，简直不可同日而语。
又是将近一刻钟过去，血脉中再无墨绿色**溢出。灵神三窍之间的空隙中，足有拇指头大小的墨绿色**已将整个瑶池穴占据，而那枚紫罗幻灵香种子则漂浮在**上面，连最初的那丝**才只吸收小半。
终于成功了！

聂空如释重负，心中颇为感慨，就这么点东西，折磨了这身体的原主人整整十八年。心念间，聂空手上动作放慢，颤栗的躯体跟着平静下来。经历轻缓的过渡后，聂空开始了九转金针的第三循环。
不久后，聂空虽开始提速，但揉捻金针时却显得特别悠然，浑不似第二循环时的激烈和狂暴。
在金针的刺激下，丝丝药力从经脉中扩散开来，化作一道道暖流渗透进肌肉和血液中。聂空身体的疲劳和疼痛渐渐驱除，浑身暖洋洋的，如沐春风。当聂空手指动作转慢时，他瘦削的面颊处已多了丝红晕。
正要收针时，聂空意外地发现，紫罗幻灵香种子稍大的那端竟裂开了一条缝隙，丝丝嫩绿色从裂缝中透出。
种子发芽了？！
content_en:
Chapter 07 Seed Germination
Nie Kong did not let go, his index finger and thumb gently twisted the Heavenly Needle, and the other eight needles trembled according to the vibration frequency of the Heavenly Needle, like spiritual living creatures.
The nine hidden points of Xinhai, Yuming, Tiangong, Heiting, Longque, Shenli, Yangfeng, Miquan and Yaochi connect the meridians in Nie Kong's body into a whole, and Yaochi point is the leader and general hub of this whole. Nie Kong used the Heavenly Needle to control the Yaochi acupoint, and Xinhai and other eight hidden acupoints also followed suit.
The nine needles responded in harmony, and gradually, Nie Kong's body began to heat up.
After about one stick of incense, Nie Kong's finger movements suddenly accelerated. The eight golden needles including the earth needle and the sky needle trembled violently, as if thousands of bees were flapping their wings at the same time, and the buzzing sound was clearly audible. On the surface of Nie Kong's body, large beads of sweat trickled out, and in an instant, the top of his head was filled with mist.
At the same time, Nie Kong's meridians and blood began to boil like boiling hot water, and bursts of thunderous roaring sounds came from his body.
Then, like ice and snow under the blazing sun, the medicinal power adhering to the meridians began to slowly melt away, and flowed towards the Yaochi point.
Seeing the strange scene in the room, the girl at the door was already dumbfounded, and her heart jumped into her throat without knowing when.
It turns out that it’s really okay to pierce such a long golden needle into your body!
Nie Kong's rapidly rubbing fingers and violently trembling golden needles dazzled people, and the beautiful eyebrows were secretly speechless. The misty mist, like the humming like a melody... all of this was seen by Huamei and listened to by her ears. Nie Kong's figure suddenly became a bit mysterious. Originally, she was half-convinced when Nie Kong said that the nine golden needles could cure diseases, but now, Huamei believed Nie Kong's words.
Thinking that Nie Kong finally had hope to get rid of the troubles of the disease, Huamei was sincerely happy. But while she was happy, she was also a little confused, where did her uncle learn this?
The medicinal power came in a steady stream and soon condensed into a ball at the head of the Heavenly Needle. For these medicinal powers, Nie Kong planned to use the vibration resonance of the nine golden needles to force them out of the body. Although these medicines are precious, the amount accumulated over more than ten years is too huge. With Nie Kong's current weak constitution, if he uses the "Nine-turn Golden Needle" technique to absorb them all, it is estimated that Nie Kong will really be killed by them.
Suddenly, the seeds of the Violet Phantom Incense began to shake.
"Ahhhh..."
Faintly, Nie Kong seemed to hear a childish cry coming from the seed, and then, a very clear desire was transmitted from the Violet Phantom Fragrance Seed to Nie Kong's heart, just like a baby's instinctive need for breast milk, and the seed for medicine.
Does this purple phantom incense seed have its own consciousness?
Nie Kong hesitated for a moment, then placed his middle finger on the rapidly rotating golden needle and tapped it slowly. The medicinal power condensed on the needle fell on the seeds.
After only a few seconds, the medicinal power was completely absorbed by the seeds.
Nie Kong was quite surprised, and even more curious about the purple phantom scent seeds. Want to see what it will look like? Nie Kong made up his mind, and more and more of the medicinal power melted from the meridians was attracted by the sky needle, and then poured onto the purple seeds.
A quarter of an hour later, Nie Kong's twisting of the Heavenly Needle slowed down. The other eight golden needles seemed to have received the order, and the frequency and amplitude of the trembling gradually became gentler. After continuing for such a long time, the medicinal power in Nie Kong's meridians melted by about 20% and was completely absorbed by the seeds.
However, Nie Kong has no tendency to stop acupuncture.
The so-called nine-turn golden needle requires a total of nine cycles.
The time just now was just the first stage of the "Nine Turns Golden Needle" technique. In his previous life, Nie Kong always decided how many cycles needed to be performed based on the patient's illness and severity. Of course, at that time, he still rarely used the Nine-turn Golden Needle. After all, this method was too energy-consuming. Yi NieSora's estimate of his physical condition was that three consecutive cycles tonight would be the limit.
For Nie Kong, tonight's first cycle was just preparation work, and melting the 20% of the medicinal power was just a convenience. The second cycle would target the root cause of the disease in the blood. As long as the root cause of the disease is solved, it is not difficult to solve the spiritual power and the remaining medicinal power that have been condensed into substance.
"Whether it will be effective or not depends on this cycle."
Nie Kong's breathing was light and his mood was peaceful. The movements of his right thumb and index finger did not gradually speed up like the previous time, but suddenly accelerated several times.
"Boom!"
Nie Kong's body shook violently, and eight golden needles including the earth needle and the human needle swayed in a circle at the same time, and then trembled rapidly in an arc shape.
The trembling and resonant power of the nine golden needles seeped into the blood along the meridians. Instantly, the blood vessels in Nie Kong's body expanded and the blood flow rate increased significantly. About two minutes later, the movement of twisting the golden needle sped up again, and a small rushing sound came from Nie Kong's body, like a stream.
"Yeah!"
Nie Kong groaned, and bursts of tearing pain spread rapidly from his blood vessels. Although the pain was excruciating, Nie Kong's thumb and index finger did not pause at all. This moment was extremely critical. A slight oversight would result in all previous efforts being wasted.
With the rapid flow of blood, heat rises from the nine hidden acupoints. In the blink of an eye, it has transformed from warm to intense, and then spreads throughout the body. Nie Kong's body turned red at a speed that was almost visible to the naked eye. In less than ten seconds, Nie Kong's entire body was as red as boiled shrimp.
Nie Kong's skin trembled all over his body, and the heat and pain made his whole body seem to explode.
At the door of the room, seeing Nie Kong's strange condition, Huamei's pretty face was full of nervousness, and her heart was lifted again. At this moment, even a fool could see that Nie Kong was undergoing unspeakable torture. At this moment, Huamei couldn't help, so she could only bite her red lips and pray secretly.
"Hiss..."
Finally, in the slight sound, Nie Kong felt the familiar strange power again. The difference is that yesterday's power was invisible and qualityless, but now, that power has condensed into traces of dark green **, separated from the blood, and gathered towards the Yaochi point.
The purple phantom incense seeds screamed "ah ah ah" again, as if they had seen some kind of rare treasure, and Nie Kong could feel a sense of joy from the sound.
Sure enough, when Nie Kong flicked the dark green ** that first arrived at the "Yaochi Point" to the surface of the Ziluo Phantom Fragrance Seed, it began to absorb it. However, this time its absorption speed is extremely slow, which is completely different from the previous absorption of medicine.
Nearly a quarter of an hour passed, and no more dark green liquid leaked out of the blood. In the gap between the three spiritual orifices, a dark green ** about the size of a thumb has occupied the entire Yaochi point, while the purple phantom spirit fragrance seed is floating on the **, and even the initial strand of ** has only absorbed less than half.
Finally succeeded!
Nie Kong was relieved and felt quite emotional. Just such a thing had tortured the original owner of this body for eighteen years. As he thought, Nie Kong slowed down his hand movements, and his trembling body calmed down. After a gentle transition, Nie Kong began the third cycle of the Nine-Turn Golden Needle.
Soon after, although Nie Kong began to increase his speed, he seemed particularly leisurely when twisting the golden needle, which was not as intense and violent as the second cycle.
Under the stimulation of the golden needles, the medicinal power spreads from the meridians, turning into warm currents and penetrating into the muscles and blood. The fatigue and pain in Nie Kong's body gradually disappeared, and his whole body felt warm, like a spring breeze. When Nie Kong's finger movements slowed down, there was already a hint of blush on his thin cheeks.
Just as he was about to retract the needle, Nie Kong unexpectedly discovered that the slightly larger end of the Violet Phantom Fragrance Seed had a crack, and traces of tender green were revealed from the crack.
Have the seeds sprouted? !
